instruction: Enable Apache mod_dav on Debian 12 and verify
output: sudo a2enmod dav dav_fs && apache2ctl -M | grep -i dav

instruction: Configure Apache DAVLockDB directory
output: sudo mkdir -p /var/www/webdav/locks && sudo chown www-data:www-data /var/www/webdav/locks && echo 'DAVLockDB /var/www/webdav/locks/DAVLock' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/dav-lockdb.conf && sudo a2enconf dav-lockdb && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Set digest auth realm for Apache WebDAV
output: echo 'AuthName "Secure WebDAV"' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Create additional htdigest user for WebDAV
output: sudo htdigest /etc/apache2/webdav.passwd 'Secure WebDAV' bob

instruction: Verify digest auth file contents
output: cat /etc/apache2/webdav.passwd

instruction: Increase WebDAV upload limit in Apache
output: echo 'LimitRequestBody 2147483648' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Check WebDAV directory listing in Apache
output: echo 'Options +Indexes' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Disable directory listing for WebDAV in Apache
output: echo 'Options -Indexes' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Set WebDAV directory to require SSL in Apache
output: echo 'SSLRequireSSL' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Log WebDAV requests in Apache to separate file
output:
echo 'SetEnvIf Request_URI "^/webdav" webdavlog
CustomLog /var/log/apache2/webdav.log combined env=webdavlog' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Check WebDAV logs in Apache
output: sudo tail -f /var/log/apache2/webdav.log

instruction: Block specific IP from accessing WebDAV
output:
echo '<Location /webdav>
    Require ip 192.168.1.0/24
</Location>' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Restrict WebDAV to authenticated users only
output:
echo '<Location /webdav>
    Require valid-user
</Location>' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Limit WebDAV access to specific HTTP methods
output:
echo '<LimitExcept GET PROPFIND OPTIONS>
    Require valid-user
</LimitExcept>' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Run git clone over WebDAV with git-http-backend
output: sudo apt install git && sudo a2enmod cgi && echo 'ScriptAlias /git /usr/lib/git-core/git-http-backend' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/git-dav.conf && sudo a2enconf git-dav && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Test WebDAV with PROPFIND and check response
output: curl -X PROPFIND http://localhost/webdav/ --user alice:secretpass -H 'Depth: 0' -w '\nHTTP Status: %{http_code}\n'

instruction: Use httpie for WebDAV MKCOL
output: http MKCOL http://localhost/webdav/newdir --auth alice:secretpass

instruction: Use httpie for WebDAV PUT
output: http PUT http://localhost/webdav/test.md @file.md --auth alice:secretpass

instruction: Use httpie for WebDAV DELETE
output: http DELETE http://localhost/webdav/unwanted.md --auth alice:secretpass

instruction: Use httpie for WebDAV PROPFIND
output: http PROPFIND http://localhost/webdav/ Depth:1 --auth alice:secretpass
